'''Iced donuts with dark matter sprinkles''' were a type of [[Doughnut/Legends|donut]] covered in [[dark matter sprinkles]]. They were served on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] where they were made by a [[Crisp-E-O donut droid]] in a traditional [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]] style every morning. They cost 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
